SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as boat_count, boat, cls 
FROM schedule 
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 273 AND fish_date_doy <= 310 AND cls = 'day_1_5'
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, boat, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, boat
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  boat,
  COUNT(*) as anglers_total,
  SUM(yt) as yt_total,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / CAST(COUNT(*) as float), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 AND cls = 'day_1_5'
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, boat
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 30
